note: Iteration-stability check of the extraction itself: every paper was extracted three times by independent blind agent runs under the identical contract, and the runs were compared claim by claim. Agreement is reported over the claims that ALL three runs found independently.

dimensions.name: sign
dimensions.comment: the direction of every shared claim matched in all three runs

dimensions.name: abstract anchor
dimensions.comment: which abstract sentence the claim hangs on

dimensions.name: instrument (raw wording)
dimensions.comment: disagreements are parenthetical rewordings of the same instrument

dimensions.name: identifying variation (raw wording)
dimensions.comment: almost all disagreements are paraphrases of the same source of variation; the field had no committed vocabulary to anchor phrasing at extraction time

numeric_pairs.comment: where two runs extracted the same (outcome, value) they agreed every time; unshared pairs are extra table columns one run covered and another skipped, never a different value for the same estimate

verbatim_snippets.comment: every evidence snippet of both reruns (1193/1193) and all but one span of the production run (1270/1271; a seven-word paper-level sentence) was programmatically located verbatim in its PDF

papers.structural: 0 claims in all 3 runs (the paper prints no abstract)
papers.highlight: the only theory divergence of the sweep: none vs verbal_mechanism, a borderline both runs flagged themselves
numeric values 15/15/15 identical; sign, support, design, instrument, anchor all 8/8
full agreement on every dimension including the variation phrase
reruns extracted strict supersets of the production run's numbers (20 shared pairs, no contradictions)
design, instrument and theory model identical; 21 shared numeric pairs
instrument differences are parentheticals on the same IVF-success phrase
the real soft spot: runs slice the income-shifting outcomes at different granularity; within shared claims sign and instrument agree 4/4
mostly a population-wording artifact (individual vs all); the same cause-effect edges exist in every run, and the theory string matched verbatim
